serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
No wonder Annalie is like she is…
You: How is it going, Annalie?
Lady Annalie: Pretty good! My sand castle is almost finished. Would you two help me a little?
You: Maybe later, I just woke up from a nap. I’m still a little dizzy.
Lady Annalie: Sure, no prob!
Bot: We will come later, I promise!
Lady Annalie: I will be waiting!
